gloss: sortie; sally; going out to attack

definitions.gloss: sortie; sally; going out to attack
definitions.explanation: A military operation in which troops or aircraft leave a base or defensive position to attack the enemy. Also used in gaming contexts for deploying or launching into battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出撃|しゅつげき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{戦闘機|せんとうき}→戦闘機：23287_sentouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出撃|しゅつげき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fighter jets sortied from the base.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{全軍|ぜんぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出撃|しゅつげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The entire army received orders to sortie before dawn.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出撃|しゅつげき}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In this game, you can deploy with your favorite character.

notes:
Composed of {出|しゅつ} (go out) and {撃|げき} (attack, strike). Describes the act of leaving a position to go on the offensive. Originally a military term, it is now commonly encountered in video games, anime, and fiction involving mecha or war themes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出撃|しゅつげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sortie, to deploy
- {出撃|しゅつげき}⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: sortie order
- {出撃|しゅつげき}⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparations for sortie
- {出撃|しゅつげき}⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧: number of sorties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進撃|しんげき}→進撃：14493_shingeki⟧: advance, charge — moving forward to attack, often in formation
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: attack — the act of attacking in general, not specifically leaving base
- ⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧: dispatch, deployment — broader term for dispatching forces, including for non-combat purposes
